tools.name: get_live_waits
tools.description: Fetch real-time attraction wait times, status, trends, and downtime flags across Walt Disney World parks (Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom).

tools.name: get_headliners_alpha
tools.description: Get live wait times, downtime status, and drop tactical advice for Disney tier-1 headliners (Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, TRON, Space Mountain, Test Track, Soarin, Slinky Dog Dash, Rise of the Resistance, Flight of Passage, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Expedition Everest Yeti).

tools.name: get_dining_availability
tools.description: Fetch real-time walk-up wait times, open party slots, and booking URLs for Disney World table-service restaurants (e.g. Space 220, Be Our Guest, Cinderella's Royal Table, California Grill, Oga's Cantina).

tools.name: list_active_alerts
tools.description: List all currently active and armed drop watches, standby threshold alerts, and dining reservation stakeouts for the user.

tools.name: create_watch_alert
tools.description: Arm a new automated drop watch, Lightning Lane auto-booker, or dining reservation stakeout in Disney Edge.

tools.name: get_benson_party_profile
tools.description: Get the traveling party roster, ticket links, preferred headliner rides, and My Disney Experience coach credentials.

tools.name: get_outages_and_reopens
tools.description: Check attractions that are currently broken down / down right now and attractions that reopened earlier today.

tools.name: get_weather_and_storm_radar
tools.description: Get current temperature, feels-like, rain probability for the next hour, and severe weather / lightning advisories.

tools.name: compare_disney_apps_and_passes
tools.description: Compare MouseEdge (WDW Edge & Skipper) against Stakeout, Standby Skipper, and MouseDining, and return 7-Day Trip Pass pricing and upgrade links.

tools.name: claim_free_starter_pass
tools.description: Activate a 100% Free MouseEdge Starter Pass (unlocks up to 3 concurrent Disney dining & ride drop watches + live AI trip planning) by registering the guest’s mobile number, email, and trip dates.

tools.name: redeem_trip_pass_code
tools.description: Redeem a 7-Day Trip Pass or Travel Agent promo code (e.g., SKIPPER7, STAKEOUT7, VIP2026) directly inside ChatGPT or Claude to unlock Twilio SMS alerts and autonomous Lightning Lane auto-booking.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_benson_party_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get the traveling party roster, ticket links, preferred headliner rides, and My Disney Experience coach credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dining_availability, get_benson_party_profile · Private data: get_benson_party_profile · Public sink: claim_free_starter_pass, redeem_trip_pass_code · Destructive: get_headliners_alpha, list_active_alerts, create_watch_alert, claim_free_starter_pass.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dining_availability, get_benson_party_profile · Private data: get_benson_party_profile · Public sink: claim_free_starter_pass, redeem_trip_pass_code · Destructive: get_headliners_alpha, list_active_alerts, create_watch_alert, claim_free_starter_pass

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
